Visitor skip action omits all headings from output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorSkipHeading struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorSkipHeading) VisitHeading(ctx htmd.NodeContext, level uint32, text string, id *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorSkipHeading{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<h1>Title</h1><p>Body text remains.</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
